name: lamf-memory
description: LAMF (Ledgered Agent Memory Fabric) native OpenClaw memory plugin (kind: memory). No external npm dependencies — Node >= 24 fetch and node:* builtins only.
comment: OpenClaw loads this plugin's TypeScript entry directly (plugins.load.paths -> <this dir>/index.ts; see DECISIONS.md §W-03). The openclaw/plugin-sdk is provided by the OpenClaw host at runtime, so it is intentionally NOT an npm dependency. TODO-BIND: if the installed OpenClaw version requires a bundled/transpiled entry, add the build step documented by that SDK — do not invent one.
